Name: PIK Deterioration Loop
Key_Insight: Floating-rate stress → Borrowers can't pay cash → PIK booked as income → NII inflated → Dividend appears covered → Cash runs dry → Forced cut → Panic. "Covered" is fiction when PIK rising.

Name: Credit Line Draw Cascade
Key_Insight: Credit stress → BDC portfolios mark down → BDCs draw bank lines ($142B unfunded, ~45% = $64B) → Bank liquidity drain → FHLB surge. Hidden second-order effect.

Name: NAV Discount Contagion
Key_Insight: Single BDC blows up → Market questions sector → Redemptions → Non-traded gates → Forced sales → Price discovery → Peer markdowns → Bank exposure crystallizes.

Name: Dividend Cut Cascade
Key_Insight: First cut = idiosyncratic. Second cut = pattern. Income investors flee → Stock collapse → NAV widens → Covenants tested → Bank exposure at risk.
